candidates.description: This vector activates on common English letter sequences and subword prefixes found in frequent vocabulary words.

This vector represents common grammatical conjunctions, prepositions, and function words across multiple languages, particularly Thai, Dutch, French, and English.
This vector detects common Thai script characters and specific proper names sharing similar subword tokenization patterns.

This feature vector activates on tokens related to religious entities, spiritual concepts, and places of worship.
